upgrade_policy: Clean Install supported; in-place upgrade not guaranteed

checkpoints.name: Fix 01 Rule Group List Page
checkpoints.summary: Make the traffic rule group first-level page a group management page.

checkpoints.name: Fix 02 Rule Group Detail Page
checkpoints.summary: Add a focused second-level manage-rules page for one custom group.

checkpoints.name: Fix 03 Chinese Matcher Labels
checkpoints.summary: Show user-facing Chinese matcher labels while preserving stored matcher values.

checkpoints.name: Fix 04 Rule Group Editing
checkpoints.summary: Support add, edit, delete, and rename operations for rule groups.

checkpoints.name: Fix 05 Direct Custom Edit
checkpoints.summary: Allow direct custom domain execution rules to be edited in place.

checkpoints.name: Fix 06 Custom Flow Separation
checkpoints.summary: Separate one-off direct custom flow from reusable custom group flow.

checkpoints.name: Fix 07 Deterministic Routing Priority
checkpoints.summary: Make Simple routing priority deterministic and independent of creation order.

checkpoints.name: Fix 08 Routing Conflict Warning
checkpoints.summary: Warn about overlapping Simple rules and explain which rule wins.

checkpoints.name: Fix 09 Rule Group Display Name
checkpoints.summary: Show real custom group names while preserving groupId binding.

checkpoints.name: Fix 10 N5 Menu Expanded
checkpoints.summary: Keep the N5 enhanced menu expanded across N5 pages, refreshes, and direct URLs.

checkpoints.name: P1-01 Egress Reference Protection
checkpoints.summary: Reject deleting egress records while policies, rules, pools, or fallbacks still reference them.

checkpoints.name: P1-02 Inbound Delete Cleanup
checkpoints.summary: Clean only the deleted inbound's Simple-managed execution state.

checkpoints.name: P1-03 Advanced Simple Protection
checkpoints.summary: Reject Advanced API mutation of Simple-managed state.

checkpoints.name: P2-01 Simple Transaction
checkpoints.summary: Wrap Simple create, update, and delete mutations in DB transactions.

checkpoints.name: P2-02 Disabled Builtin Protection
checkpoints.summary: Backend rejects new Simple execution creation for disabled builtin groups.

checkpoints.name: RC-01 Mobile Release Readiness
checkpoints.summary: Make N5 mobile table actions and modal footers reachable.

checkpoints.name: RC-02 SQLite Busy Handling
checkpoints.summary: Sanitize SQLite busy/locked errors and avoid raw SQL or HTTP 500 leakage.
